```sql
with fx as (
    select c.rate_date,
           c.currency,
           cast(c.usd_per_unit / r.usd_per_unit as decimal(38,12)) as to_reporting
    from fx_rates c
    join fx_rates r on r.rate_date = c.rate_date and r.currency = 'USD'
),
captures as (
    select a.attempt_id,
           a.acquiring_bank,
           a.amount_minor,
           a.currency,
           a.business_date,
           row_number() over (
               partition by a.order_id, a.amount_minor
               order by a.attempt_no, a.attempt_id
           ) as capture_rank
    from payment_attempts a
    where a.status = 'captured'
      and not a.is_test
      and a.business_date <= date '2026-07-31'
),
settled_by_end_july as (
    select distinct si.attempt_id
    from settlement_items si
    join settlements s on s.settlement_id = si.settlement_id
    where s.settled_on <= date '2026-07-31'
)
select c.acquiring_bank as key,
       cast(round(sum(c.amount_minor * fx.to_reporting)) as bigint) as value
from captures c
join fx on fx.currency = c.currency and fx.rate_date = c.business_date
left join settled_by_end_july sb on sb.attempt_id = c.attempt_id
where c.capture_rank = 1
  and sb.attempt_id is null
group by c.acquiring_bank
order by value desc, key asc
```
